With an exclusive focus on Artificial Intelligence and Big Data, Addepto helps organizations unlock the full potential of their data through systems designed for measurable business impact and long-term growth. The company’s work extends beyond client engagements. Drawing from real-world challenges and insights, Addepto has developed its own product – ContextClue – and actively contributes open-source solutions to the AI community. This commitment to transforming practical experience into scalable innovation has earned Addepto recognition by Forbes as one of the top 10 AI consulting companies worldwide . As part of KMS Technology , a US-based global technology group, Addepto combines deep AI specialization with enterprise-scale delivery capabilities—enabling the partnership to move clients from AI experimentation to production impact, securely and at scale. We are looking for an ambitious and motivated AI Engineer with a solid software engineering background in Python . This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to grow their skills in the field of Generative AI and LLMs . You will work with an experienced team that supports professional growth and ensures every project is a learning opportunity. If you’re comfortable with backend development and have a keen interest in data science and frontend technologies, this is the perfect role for you. Here are some of the projects we are seeking talented individuals to join: An AI-powered platform for industrial engineering , where you will build a backend system that utilizes LLMs to transform complex technical documents into a structured knowledge graph. This work enables our clients to leverage advanced features such as semantic search, automated documentation, and smarter knowledge management. Implementation, deployment, and ongoing development of an automotive data solution , this includes the processing and analysis of various document types, with a strong focus on digital file formats. The core functionality involves extracting key information and identifying complex relationships between disparate data sources. The solution also features seamless integration with the client’s existing infrastructure. Development of AI solutions to support software engineering , this involves building a system for advanced analysis of source code repositories, seeking relationships based on files and documentation. It also includes creating a system of grammatical rules for unknown programming languages and automatically generating training content based on these rules. Celebrate work anniversaries, birthdays, and milestones. Access medical and sports packages , eye care, and well-being support services, including psychotherapy and coaching. Get full work equipment for optimal productivity, including a laptop and other necessary devices. With our backing, you can boost your personal brand by speaking at conferences, writing for our blog, or participating in meetups. Experience a smooth onboarding with a dedicated buddy, and start your journey in our friendly, supportive, and autonomous culture. In this position, you will: Support the development of scalable AI systems, including LLMs and GenAI , under the guidance of senior engineers. Assist in transforming Data Science prototypes into production-ready solutions. Build and enhance backend components for advanced AI systems using Python and frameworks like FastAPI. Ensure code quality and implement good software engineering practices. Participate in the deployment and maintenance of solutions in a cloud environment (GCP, AWS, Azure). Hands-on experience with LLMs (Large Language Models) and Generative AI . A solid understanding of software design principles . Experience with backend frameworks (e.g., FastAPI) and databases (SQL/NoSQL). Familiarity with Docker , Git , and basic CI/CD concepts. Practical experience working in a cloud environment (AWS, GCP, Azure). Nice to have: A personal project or practical experience with frontend frameworks (e.g., React , Node.js , Nest.js , Typescript ). Practical experience and strong interest in Data Science and Machine Learning . Working shoulder to shoulder with our delivery managers, you figure out what a client actually needs, run discovery, and shape what’s worth building and why — usually across several projects at once. On the engagements where the product question is make-or-break, you go deeper and own the product direction end to end. You own the “what and why”; the delivery manager owns the “how” — two halves of the same job. About deepsense.ai deepsense.ai is a 120-person AI/ML consultancy with Anthropic and OpenAI partner credentials. For over a decade we’ve delivered applied AI projects for companies like J&J, Sky, John Deere, and GLS — spanning LLM applications, agents, MLOps, and data science. We’re a people-first organization that believes in deep technical craft and real ownership. About the role You work alongside our delivery managers as their product and discovery counterpart on shared engagements. Most of the time that’s advisory: you dip into several projects, run client discovery, shape the direction, and keep the work pointed at real user value while the delivery manager runs delivery. On engagements where product direction is make-or-break — and especially where the client doesn’t bring their own product lead — you go deep and take ownership of the product: the priorities, the backlog, the what-next. Either way, you own the product question — what we build and why. The delivery manager owns the rest (the plan, the client relationship, the team). You’re the one making sure we build the right thing — and you also help level up our own product muscle on the initiatives we build for ourselves. Responsibilities Partner with delivery managers as the product and user lens across several engagements — run discovery, shape what’s worth building, and keep a clear view of the user value behind it Run client discovery and facilitation — uncover what clients actually need (not just what they ask for), surface the use-cases worth pursuing, and turn that into a clear direction the team can build On product-critical engagements, take ownership of the product direction — the priorities, the backlog, and the what-next — in partnership with the delivery manager Be the user-and-value counterpart during pre-sales and scoping — make sure proposals are grounded in real product value, not just technical feasibility Translate between what AI can do and what users actually need — keep both honest Help level up our internal product capability — bring discovery and prioritisation discipline to the projects we build for ourselves You must have 6-8 years in product management, product ownership, or product consulting, with real responsibility for shaping what gets built and why. You’ve shaped product vision and strategy, designed experiences from concept to prototype, and collaborated with engineers and business stakeholders. A track record of running discovery and turning ambiguous client needs into a clear, prioritised product direction Strong facilitation and stakeholder skills — you can run a discovery workshop that actually shifts how a team thinks, and hold the line on priorities Enough AI/LLM product fluency to shape these products honestly — you know what LLMs and agents can and can’t do well Comfort working across several engagements at once, and going deep on the ones that need it. Xebia is a global AI-first, digital transformation, and engineering partner. With over 25 years of experience and a team of 5,000 professionals across 16 countries, we help organizations design and build scalable products, platforms, and data-driven solutions. 

 

We specialize in Artificial Intelligence, Data and Cloud, Intelligent Automation, and Digital Products, combining deep technical expertise with a strong focus on engineering excellence and a people-first culture.  

 

In the CEE region, we’re a team of nearly 1,000 experts delivering modern applications, data platforms, and AI solutions for clients such as McLaren, Aviva, Deloitte, Spotify, Disney, ING, UPS, Tesco, Truecaller, AllSaints, Volotea, Schmitz Cargobull, Allegro, InPost, and many, many more. We work with leading technologies including AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, and Snowflake, and combine strong engineering culture with a consulting mindset and a continuous focus on growth and knowledge sharing. 

 

About the role:

 

The project focuses on augmenting business and data analysts using AI agents built on top of the Databricks ecosystem. The goal is to accelerate insight generation, reduce manual analytical effort, and improve decision-making quality across Operations, Finance, and Digital domains.

You will be:

  • leading discovery workshops to define what “analyst augmentation” means in practical, measurable terms.
  • identifying and prioritizing high-value analyst workflows (OPS, Finance, Digital),
  • defining success metrics such as analyst time reduction, query accuracy, and turnaround time,
  • auditing existing Databricks data assets, pipelines, and governance constraints,
  • preparing AI-ready datasets, including metadata, documentation, and semantic layers,
  • designing and prototyping AI agents that replicate or support analyst tasks,
  • implementing agents using Databricks tools (e.g., Genie, Unity Catalog),
  • defining and implementing guardrails (security, cost control, hallucination prevention),
  • evaluating AI agent performance against human analyst benchmarks,
  • supporting pilot deployment to a limited group of business users,
  • measuring business impact and contributing to ROI and scaling recommendations,
  • helping define the roadmap from proof-of-concept to production deployment.

Your profile:

  • strong experience in data analytics, data engineering, or analytics platform delivery,
  • hands-on experience with Databricks (including Unity Catalog and governed data access),
  • experience working with SQL and analytical data models,
  • solid understanding of data governance, security, and access control concepts,
  • experience designing or working with AI/LLM-based solutions in an analytics context,
  • ability to translate business workflows into technical and AI-enabled solutions,
  • strong stakeholder communication skills and experience working with business analysts,
  • experience with semantic layers, business glossaries, or metadata management,
  • familiarity with AI agent design, prompt engineering, or orchestration frameworks,
  • experience benchmarking AI outputs against human performance,
  • exposure to enterprise analytics environments (Finance, Operations, Digital domains),
  • experience working in pilot or POC-style engagements leading to production decisions.

Work from the European Union region and a work permit are required.

Nice to have:

  • experience with automated reporting or anomaly detection use cases,
  • knowledge of cost monitoring and optimization for AI/analytics workloads,
  • experience defining operating models (human-in-the-loop vs. autonomous AI),
  • background in large-scale consumer or retail organizations,
  • consulting or advisory experience in analytics or AI transformation programs.

 

Recruitment Process:

CV review – HR call – Interview – Client Interview – Decision
